mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wrong_question (user_id, question_id, category_id, wrong_count, last_wrong_answer, last_wrong_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{categoryId}, 1, #{lastWrongAnswer}, #{lastWrongAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE wrong_count = wrong_count + 1, category_id = #{categoryId}, last_wrong_answer = #{lastWrongAnswer}, last_wrong_at = #{lastWrongAt}
